source:
3d Create a Roblox multiplayer game called "ESCAPE FROM INVINCIBLE!"

Game mechanics:

- Players must escape from Invincible.
- Invincible should be a powerful NPC that chases players around the map.
- Create a large city map with buildings, streets, parks, tunnels, and hiding spots.
- Players must run, avoid obstacles, and escape from Invincible.
- Add a warning system when Invincible gets close to a player.
- If Invincible catches a player, send them back to the starting point.
- Add multiple checkpoints throughout the map.
- Players earn coins by surviving and traveling longer distances.
- Coins can be used to buy speed boosts and cosmetic effects.
- Add a leaderboard showing the players with the longest escape distance.
- Add random events, such as Invincible becoming faster or obstacles appearing on the map.
- Make the game work on PC, mobile, and console.
- Use fun Roblox-style 3D graphics and animations.
- Make all major systems functional using Roblox Studio Luau scripts.
- Game title: "ESCAPE FROM INVINCIBLE!"

image_prompt.text: Alleys, gaps between buildings, and small nooks across the city where a player can break Invincible's line of sight
City buildings players can run into and hide inside
Large doors or hatches set into the edge of the city
A large city of streets and buildings laid out with no dead ends, so a fleeing player is never cornered
Public parks between the city blocks
Tunnels running under the streets as alternate routes
Obstacles in the streets that players have to run around while being chased
Checkpoint pads placed along the routes through the city

layout_placement.text: Where Invincible enters the map and the ground it patrols while hunting players
An exit in the outer boundary acting as a round-win trigger
Multiple checkpoints through the map that move the point a caught player is sent back to
The starting point players are returned to when Invincible catches them

notes: Zero dead ends is a hard topology property for this shape - the P6 pass has to guarantee loop connectivity in the street grid, an image cannot.
Tunnels under the streets are stacked surfaces, which is why P2 is on the route; drop it if the tunnels are meant to be flat side-passages instead.
The preset's escape gate conflicts with the stated loop - kept in the handoff but see preset_rejected.
No option covered checkpoints in this genre; they are carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: Is there any way to actually win a round - an exit to reach - or is the loop endless with distance as the only score?
How big should the city be - a few blocks, or a sprawl that takes minutes to cross?

theme: Stylized / Toon - fun Roblox-style graphics over a modern urban city

coverage_missing.ask: Does a round ever end, or is this endless distance scoring?
How large is the city meant to be?
Are the tunnels a real second level under the streets, or just covered side-passages?

answers.ask: Is there any way to actually win a round - an exit to reach - or is the loop endless with distance as the only score?
answers.answer: The loop is endless; players survive, travel distance, earn coins, and compete for the longest escape distance until they are caught.

answers.ask: How big should the city be - a few blocks, or a sprawl that takes minutes to cross?
answers.answer: Use a few connected city blocks with streets, a park, tunnels, buildings, and hiding spots so the map stays dense and replayable.
